Add a post-roll test: when only the capped remnant is selectable after a low roll, _select_post_roll_charge_targets still returns it.
grafts: From the game code review of CH-OVERKILL's scope: use the adjusted score only to choose the target within a unit. Carry the chosen target's unadjusted score into unit_best, best_score and the charge bar, so that _build_charge_order and the charge / no-charge decision stay as in base.

From the narrow code review: replace the 2.0x step with a continuous credit, min(D, k x HP) with k about 1.3. This removes the non-monotone jump; for example, Deffkoptas against the Mek sit at exactly 2.00x.

Fix the cause of the second leg, from the narrow code review. _score_multi_target_combo's spread check (charger reach + 4" for multi-model units) accepted the 8.72"-apart remnant + Blade Champion pair at s7480. Either tighten that check, or make the post-roll step keep the highest-value subset the move can cover instead of the nearest target.

From root, for a later round as its own sub-param: CT-FALLBACK. Pair it with a fallback-aware Command Re-roll: pass the provisional selectable_targets into roll_context, and treat a roll that reaches a selectable target as made. Also divide ch_short_charge out of the fallback value.

From game, for a later round as its own sub-param: when a combo's EV ties its top target's single score (every extra floored at 0), collapse the combo to the top target at the combo's EV, not drop it. Do this only after folding Attached units.
From the root and game reviews: longer term, replace the hard cap with E[min(D, HP)] plus a P(kill)-weighted kill value, so that kill certainty is priced.

From the game-lens review, as a follow-up with its own FIX param: FOCUS-CHARGE reads flags.is_engaged, which only FightPhase sets. At s7480, P2's Blade Champion C has in_engagement but not is_engaged, so charging the enemy it is locked with earned no gang-up bonus. Detect engagement from geometry, then replay s7480 and s7431.
extra_checks: Replay s7480 r3 P2 with the revised fix over 24 fresh seeds, not the discovery seeds. Expect the Blade Champion Alpha declaration and an E comparable to +5.75. Report it next to the horizon-2 (pr12h2) result for s7480. If that result is FADED, flag it before the bench.

Run real-save decision checks at s7431 r3 P1 (must keep Blade Champion Alpha), s7403 r3 P1, s7466 r3 P2, s7465 r2 P2, s7470 r2 P2 (_1 and _2), s7480 r3 P1, s7467 r2 P1, s7461 r3 P2 and s7465 r2 P1. Any changed declaration at a clear or harmful position needs a 24-seed A/B. If s7431 r3 changes at all, park the fix with FIX_CHARGE_TARGET=0.

V2-1 fix gate: play 1 pair per fixture (cus 91000, asy 91100, ork 91200, --rules11e) with the fix in the candidate seat. Report the [CHARGE_TARGET] lines and the 'changed' declarations per game per fixture. Also count SKIP_CHARGE after a successful roll ('cannot complete the charge move') against base, to catch CT-COMBO move failures.
Parameter-0 identity: one full bench game per fixture with FIX_CHARGE_TARGET=0 and the same seeds must give action logs identical to base.

Unit tests: the new full-health Blade Champion and Prosecutors no-cap cases, the Attached-unit fold case, the co-engageable combo that must be kept, and the post-roll re-pick. Rerun test_ai_charge_decisions, test_ai_11e_charge_ev_primary_cap, test_t001_t002_ai_charge_fight, test_custodes_codex_other and the 21 related tests the designer listed.
Play one bundle reach pair per fixture with the other round-5 winners merged, to check interactions before the V2-2 bench.
verdict.merge_risk:
Medium. The cluster rests on one clear 24-seed position, s7480 r3 P2. Its alternative kills a CHARACTER while the decider holds Assassination, so part of the +5.75 may be mission value that an overkill cap does not model. As submitted, the 2x gate fires on full-health lone Blade Champions (13.89 dmg vs 6 W), Prosecutors and small Ork units in the bench rosters. By the score math from the logged record, it also flips the measured-harmful guard s7431 r3 P1 to an attached 7-W leader. No one replayed that, and all three designs share it.

With the required depletion gate and the CHARACTER / kill-card exemption, the fix becomes rare in the bench (about 0.5-2 changed declarations per game). Its own effect will be too small for the bench to resolve, so it will be measured mainly through the round-5 bundle. Harm from CT-COMBO or Attached-unit interactions in real games cannot show on the bench, because the fixtures have no Attached units.

The only full-game evidence so far is one Custodes-mirror pair (E -6.0, noise). Park the fix (FIX_CHARGE_TARGET=0) in any of these cases: the revised fix still changes the s7431 r3 declaration, the fresh-seed or horizon-2 replay of s7480 fades, or the reach run shows extra SKIP_CHARGE after successful rolls.
